bundle.shortDescription: Fit Markov ion-channel models to patch-clamp data
bundle.longDescription: ICMM (Ion Channel Model Maker) fits Markov-state kinetic models of ion channels to patch-clamp electrophysiology data with CMA-ES. It searches many candidate state graphs and ranks the models it finds by how well they predict data held back for validation. A fit runs on your own computer, or on a SLURM cluster you reach over SSH, where your runs keep going when you close the app.
